transcript.text: Hi everyone. We're approaching the readiness review for the real-time collaboration service launch on Monday at 09:00 UTC. Before we finalize the launch plan, I want to make sure backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success all get their final check-in. Has anyone identified any concerns with the current draft plan — the 10% rollout, 10,000 concurrent connection cap, 5-second retry interval, primary production region storage, or 90-day transcript retention?

transcript.text: I need to flag a concern with the 5-second retry interval. The rollout policy should set the retry interval to exactly 30 seconds. I have not yet filed the client-library ticket for this.

transcript.text: I need to flag two privacy concerns with the current draft plan. I finished a privacy review this morning and confirmed that collaboration content for EU accounts must remain in the EU processing region, not the primary production region. Additionally, session transcripts must be deleted after exactly 30 days, not the 90 days currently in the draft. I haven't opened the compliance ticket yet because legal was still reviewing the wording, but these requirements need to be reflected in the launch plan before it's finalized.
